notes.text: Salary tables: 6 tranches from 01/04/2023 through 01/02/2027, Allegato 11 (PDF p. 98) of the Testo Unico CCNL DMO of 29/09/2025 (Federdistribuzione), Art. 196 for the tranche dates. Level IV on 01/04/2023 is printed 1112,46 in the PDF itself: the total 1646,68 less the contingenza 524,22, and 1192,46 less the 70,00 of Art. 196, give 1122.46, the value kept.
Split model confirmed: total / 168 at L1 = 14.905, L4 = 10.605, L7 = 8.309 — all non-integer. Source: Art. 194 (divisore 168 for 40h/week), Allegato 11.
Contingenza: frozen values from Allegato 11 column. EDR (lire 20,000 = 10.33 EUR) conglobated into contingenza on 01/01/1995 per Art. 190 — no separate EDR allowance modelled.

Terzo elemento nazionale (Art. 199, PDF p. 59): EUR 2.07 a month only for the workers of firms in provinces with no provincial terzo elemento in force (Art. 198, frozen since 1973): gated by EmployerProfile.provincial_pay_element. The provincial amounts themselves are set by provincial agreements outside the Testo Unico and are not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Model the provincial terzi elementi of Art. 198 as a territorial supplement.

notes.text: Indennità di funzione Quadri (Art. 113): EUR 260.76/month for 14 months (cumulative increments: 51.65+77.47+51.65+70.00+10.00=260.77; 0.01 rounding from lire). Allegato 11 shows 260.76.
Altri elementi of level VII: EUR 5.16/month (lire 10,000), column 'altri elementi' of Allegato 11 (PDF p. 98); the Testo Unico names no article for it.
Seniority: 10 scatti triennali (Art. 188), amounts of the Art. 188 table, in force since 1 January 1990; paid from the month after the triennium (c. 4).

APPRENTICESHIP PROFILES OF TABELLA B (Art. 61): 48 months for the listed profiles ending at levels II and III (track tabella_b_48_mesi), 42 months for those ending at level IV (tabella_b_42_mesi), two levels below for the first half and one below for the second. An apprentice of levels II, III and IV states Apprentice.track: standard_II_V for the 36 months of the other profiles.

SICKNESS (Art. 170): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay ('retribuzione giornaliera netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota, as for the Commercio file. The exempt events of c. 3 are an input (SicknessEpisode.short_absence_exempt, read with carenza_by_event) (review of 2026-10-30).

limitation.remediation: Model the net daily pay of Art. 170.

notes.text: Art. 202: the indennità di cassa of 5%.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: every level carries IND_CASSA, 5% of its paga base nazionale conglobata, for the role cassiere of Employment.roles.

notes.text: The pay rows of the operatori di vendita.

limitation.remediation: Add the operatori di vendita levels.
Model the pay of the Art. 70 contract.

notes.text: Art. 201: the guarantee of the commission-paid staff. The una tantum of Art. 197 (July 2024 and 2025) is historic and outside the TFR base (c. 6).

limitation.remediation: Model the guarantee of commission-paid staff.

notes.text: HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS (artt. 18-20, pp. 15-16): E.Bi.Di.M. 0.10% + 0.05% of paga base and contingenza on 14 months, Fondo EST EUR 10 (13 from April 2025) + 2 a month for the permanent non-quadri, Cassa QuAS EUR 350/370/390 + 56 a year for the quadri; the elements of an employer that does not pay them (0.30%, EUR 16 and 37 on 14 months) when it states so in EmployerProfile.contractual_funds.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: parameters.health_funds ebidim, fondo_est and quas, read on 2026-11-05.

notes.text: LEAVE, WEEKLY SCHEDULE: a 39-hour full-time week absorbs 36 hours of ROL and a 38-hour week 16 hours of ex festività and 56 of ROL, read from Employment.full_time_weekly_hours. The grandi magazzini, magazzini a prezzo unico, supermercati alimentari, cash&carry and ipermercati (Art. 119, EmployerProfile.subsector 'grande_distribuzione') on a 38-hour average absorb instead the 56 hours of Art. 141 c. 3 and the 16 of c. 4 and keep the ex festività.

ORDINARY HOUR PREMIUMS (Testo Unico 29 September 2025, pp. 43-44): ordinary night 15% (art. 134), Sunday 30% (art. 136 c. 7, without a better second-level treatment), weekly rest day 30% (art. 139), holidays as straordinario festivo 30% with the hour paid apart (art. 138): work_rules.time_supplements.supplement_bands DMO_*.
INJURY (Art. 172 c. 2): the top-up reaches 100% of the net daily pay from day 21; the model applies one rate, 90% (the rate of days 5-20), so from day 21 the injury pay is 10 points short.

limitation.remediation: Model day bands for the injury top-up (60/90/100% of Art. 172).

location.section: Art. 142 - Ferie, Chiarimento a verbale
location.quote: Nella ipotesi di risoluzione del rapporto di lavoro, l’indennità sostitutiva delle ferie si calcola dividendo per ventisei la retribuzione mensile di fatto di cui all’art. 191.

provenance.transformation: Ferie: residual days x monthly pay / 26, as quoted. location.section: Art. 145 c.1 - Normativa per cessazione rapporto

provenance.note: Twelfths of the 26 days per month of effective service. The text does not say how a month served in part counts for the ferie: month_credit is left open, so a partial month accrues nothing and the balance is marked inexact.

location.section: Art. 141 c.1 - Permessi retribuiti
location.quote: Gruppi di 4 o di 8 ore di permesso individuale retribuito, in sostituzione delle 4 festività abolite dal combinato disposto della Legge 5 marzo 1977, n. 54, e del D.P.R. 28 dicembre 1985, n. 792, verranno fruiti dai lavoratori, a partire dal 1° gennaio 1980.

provenance.transformation: 32 hours = the 4 abolished festivities of comma 1 times a working day of 8 hours: the clause grants the hours in groups of 4 or 8 in place of the 4 festivities and states no total. Whole months only, Art. 141 c.7 (p. 45): 'un dodicesimo dei permessi di cui al presente articolo per ogni mese intero di servizio prestato'. Accrued in full by every worker, the hires after 1 March 2011 included (c.8 keeps 'il godimento delle ore di permesso di cui al primo comma').

location.quote: 4. In caso di coincidenza di una delle festività sopra elencate con una domenica, in aggiunta alla retribuzione mensile sarà corrisposto ai lavoratori un ulteriore importo pari alla quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art. 191. 5. [Dichiarazione a verbale] Le Parti si danno atto che, in caso di entrata in vigore della Legge istitutiva della festività del 4 ottobre - Festa Nazionale di San Francesco d'Assisi Patrono d'Italia, quest'ultima si intende automaticamente recepita quale festività retribuita. provenance.transformation: The holidays of art. 137 (but the Patrono), 4 October once in force (L. 151/2025, from 2026) by the dichiarazione a verbale, on a Sunday, and 4 November on the first Sunday of November: the retribuzione di fatto of art. 191 (every continuing element of the chain) over 26 (art. 193).
provenance.note: The Patrono is not in the national calendar and is not paid.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule read again in the Testo Unico of 29 September 2025 (Federdistribuzione, 99 pages), for the production tier.
findings: 90 records verified; the work rules cited an aggregator and now cite the Testo Unico. The 2025/01 URL of the sources returns 404: replaced by the 2026/04 one.

Night overtime 50%, not 30% (Art. 132 c. 3); added the 20% beyond the 48th weekly hour (c. 1). The premiums are on the normale retribuzione of Art. 189 (hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances, which documents the rule: the caller states OvertimeEvent.hourly_rate).
Sickness: 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21 of the net daily pay, carenza by event, apprentices excluded (Art. 170), not a flat 100%.
Seniority amounts in force since 1990 (Art. 188): the gap before 23 April 2024 removed.
Terzo elemento 2.07 due only without a provincial element (Art. 199): now gated.
Apprenticeship: second half of level VI at VII (Art. 46 c. 3); the 36-month end of levels II-V stated.
Added the payment days of the tredicesima and quattordicesima and Fon.Te. (Art. 95, 1.55% and 0.55%, apprentices 1.05%).
Night holiday overtime 0.50 stays derived: no clause sets it, Art. 132 c. 5 forbids cumulation.
No renewal after the Testo Unico through October 2026.
sickness_net_basis is recorded on every run with a sickness event (trigger run), not only documented.

reviews.scope: The paga base, contingenza, terzo elemento, indennità di funzione and scatti of every level against the Testo Unico of 29 September 2025, and a year and a termination of a level IV worker against a hand oracle.
findings: Allegato 11 (PDF pp. 97-99): 47 of the 48 paghe base of the file are printed in the tables; the IV of 1 April 2023 prints 1112,46 in the paga base column, but its total 1646,68 less the contingenza 524,22 gives the 1122,46 of the file, which the CCNL Terziario Confesercenti also reaches (total 1646,68). The paga base column has a misprint; the file keeps 1122,46.
Contingenza + EDR of every level, the terzo elemento of 2,07 (Art. 195), the indennità di funzione of the Quadri (260,76) and of the VII (5,16) and the scatti (Quadri 25,46 to VII 19,47): match.
Art. 204 and 205 (PDF p. 59): tredicesima at Christmas, quattordicesima of the pay in force on 30 June paid on 1 July, in twelfths of the twelve months before. Match.

Hand oracle (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector, scenarios dmo-year and dmo-june): a level IV impiegato hired on 1 January 2026 by an employer with 50 employees where a provincial element is in force; every payment and the year (gross, contributions, tax, net, TFR, employer cost) match the engine to the cent. The CCNL now covers every total of the definition of done.

reviews.scope: The basis of the indemnity for the leave not taken at the end of the employment, read in the Testo Unico of 29 September 2025 (Artt. 79, 141, 142, 191, 193, 194).
findings: Art. 142 - Ferie, Chiarimento a verbale (p. 45): the indemnity of the ferie at the end of the employment is the retribuzione mensile di fatto divided by twenty-six: work_rules.leave_rules.termination; the accrual of the leave is not modelled, so the basis is not used yet.

reviews.scope: The accrual of the ferie, the ex festività and the ROL read in the Testo Unico of 29 September 2025 (Artt. 141, 142, 145).
findings: Art. 145 c.1 (p. 45): twelfths of the 26 days of Art. 142 per month of effective service, no month-fraction rule: work_rules.leave_rules.ferie_accrual.
Art. 141 cc.1, 3, 4, 7 (pp. 44-45): 32 hours of ex festività (4 festività in groups of 8 hours), 56 hours of permits up to 15 employees and 72 above, by whole months: work_rules.leave_rules.permits.
Art. 141 c.8 (p. 45): the 56/72 hours of a hire after 1 March 2011 at 0%, 50% after two years, 100% after four: permits[rol].ramp.

reviews.scope: The hourly divisors of the 42 and 45 hour weeks, Art. 194 - Quota oraria (p. 58).
findings: Art. 194 - Quota oraria (p. 58): 168 for a normal week of 40 hours, 182 for 42, 195 for 45: work_rules.time_supplements.hourly_divisor_weekly_hours 40 and week_divisors 42/182, 45/195.

Artt. 231, 232, 233 c. 3, 236 c. 2 (pp. 64-66): calendar days by level and service for dismissal and resignation, from the 1st or the 16th, indemnity on the retribuzione di fatto with the 13th and 14th ratei, out of the TFR base: work_rules.notice. Found by a delegated search, checked again on the PDF text.

reviews.scope: The premiums on ordinary hours of Artt. 134, 136, 138 and 139 and the hourly base of Artt. 189, 191 and 194 (PDF pp. 42-44 and 57-58).
findings: Art. 134 (p. 43): ordinary night 15%; art. 136 c. 7 (p. 43): Sunday 30%; art. 139 (p. 44): weekly rest day 30%; art. 138 (p. 44): holidays as straordinario festivo 30% (art. 132), the hour paid apart: supplement_bands DMO_*, as Commercio artt. 151-156.

Art. 194 (p. 58) divisor 168 at 40 hours; art. 189 (p. 57, read on the page image) normale retribuzione: paga base, contingenza, terzi elementi, scatti, other bargained elements; art. 191 adds the continuative individual elements: hourly_base_provenance and individual_elements hour_only, as Commercio artt. 206-211.

reviews.scope: Artt. 18-20 (PDF pp. 15-16), 191 and 233 of the Testo Unico of 29 September 2025, text layer.
findings: The three funds and their alternative elements were not modelled: employer cost, worker shares and the EDR of an employer that does not pay them were missing.
